summary: Open-source gateway for self-hosted AI models that optimizes costs and trains specialized models by learning from your traffic.
usecases: Dynamically route inference traffic to optimal marketplace models for cost reduction.
Self-host and fine-tune a proprietary AI model using traffic-derived insights.
Eliminate vendor lock-in by switching between 1000+ supported models.
ideas: Integrate with CI/CD pipelines for automated model retraining on new data.
Build a real-time dashboard comparing model performance and cost metrics.
Develop IDE plugins that suggest model switches based on code context.
